description: Ziwei Dou Shu charting, palace inspection, and MCP tools for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Use structured Ziwei Dou Shu chart tools in Codex.
interface.longDescription: ZiweiMaster exposes Ziwei Dou Shu charting and palace-inspection tools to Codex through MCP. It can generate natal charts, decade charts, annual charts, LLM-ready analysis payloads, inspect a palace as if clicked in the UI, resolve China prefecture-level birthplaces for true solar time, and parse common Chinese natural-language birth inputs.
